##### Project general facts

OXO The Residences is a visionary freehold development co-created by OXO Living and the masterminds behind most anticipated creative city. Designed by renowned architect Alexis Dornier, this exclusive gated community features a limited collection of contemporary villas, each crafted as a seamless blend of tropical modernism and industrial elegance. Set within a serene landscape, the residences offer a rare opportunity for freehold ownership in Bali, providing discerning investors with complete control, long-term security, and generational wealth.

Residents enjoy a thoughtfully curated ecosystem designed for connection and wellbeing. The complex features a clubhouse, lush themed gardens, a children’s playground, an outdoor BBQ area, an outdoor fitness zone, and EV charging stations. Wide streets and landscaped pathways invite leisurely strolls, while the gated environment ensures privacy and safety for families. Shared spaces are intentionally designed to foster authentic interactions and quality time, offering everything residents need and nothing they don’t.

Every villa at OXO The Residences is a sanctuary of understated luxury. Interiors feature polished concrete floors, marble finishes, veneer wood ceilings, and off-white painted walls. Kitchens are state-of-the-art with marble countertops, built-in ovens, electric stoves, premium refrigerators, and reverse osmosis drinking water systems. Bedrooms boast built-in walk-in closets, queen-size headboards, and en-suite bathrooms with marble tiled walls, copper-plated faucets, and glass shower screens. Optional furniture packages and customizable multi-function rooms allow owners to tailor their space for a bedroom, office, fitness room, or entertainment suite.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled in the up-and-coming Nyanyi area on Bali’s southwest coast, this exceptional location places residents at the heart of the island’s next lifestyle destination, following the evolution of Kuta, Seminyak, Canggu, and Pererenan. Nyanyi is home to Nuanu, a visionary creative city spanning lush beachfront land, dedicated to preserving nature, art, culture, education, wellness, and harmonious living. The area is defined by its commitment to sustainability, with most of the land remaining green and untouched, offering a true escape into tropical beauty.

The location is distinguished by its perfect balance of seclusion and connectivity. Just a short drive from the iconic Tanah Lot temple and the vibrant energy of Canggu, it offers easy access to world-class surfing beaches, international schools, and the island’s most exciting new cultural and entertainment venues. The international airport is also within comfortable reach, ensuring seamless travel for global citizens.

For those seeking a residence that embodies freedom, nature, and community, Nyanyi delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of pristine landscapes, visionary development, and strong growth potential makes it one of Bali’s most promising addresses. This is a place where one can enjoy the best of Balimserene, inspiring and effortlessly connected
